SELECT p.category,
       SUM(i.unit_price_minor * i.quantity) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category;

ORDER BY month;

SELECT c.segment,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id

WITH s AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC) AS r
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM s
WHERE r = 1;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS total
    FROM orders o

FROM v

       (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars

ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, o.id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.category,
       SUM(i.unit_price_minor * i.quantity) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS amount_dollars
FROM order_items AS i
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category;

       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /

FROM customers c

GROUP BY c.segment;

WITH s AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
), r AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS rk
    FROM s
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS total

WITH s AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
), r AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS rk
    FROM s
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1;

GROUP BY topic;

WITH v AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS total
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM v
WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM v);

SELECT o.id,
       (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) * 1.0
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY 2 DESC, o.id
LIMIT 3;
